paragraphs.text: The Official Guide to Tempest is a complete companion to the Tempest card set. It was written by Beth Moursund , who was a contributor to The Duelist at the time. It is a softcover paperback with 124 pages, and was published by Running Press on Janauary 11, 1998.

This book contains all that you need to know about Tempest , the standalone expansion for Magic: The Gathering . Every Tempest card is discussed and rated. Tips are given on playing the cards - when to use them for best effect and which combinations will be most devastating. Every card from Tempest is reproduced in full color. A must players and collectors!

This guide gives tips for playing in a Tempest -only environment and how to best use Tempest cards with Fifth Edition . There are full-color reproductions of all of the Tempest cards, along with information on the rarity of the cards and current errata.
